name: Artistic Volume Rendering Template
definition: A direct volume rendering approach using shader program templates. Viewing rays are cast through volume, sampled at equidistant positions. Opacity transfer function determines visibility. Color evaluation depends on fuzzy logic rules via artistic styles.
summary: Artistic Volume Rendering Template maps volumetric data to visual styles using fuzzy logic and shaded sphere images, differing from standard methods by decoupling color evaluation into prioritized, compositable style layers.
